ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 18% high-intensity (white) pixels to 82% low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity blobs are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes. Linear, high-contrast filaments radiate from the central peduncle region toward the trailing edges across the dark medial zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated vertex angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.14 relative to the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) of 5-15 pixels occurring continuously along the trailing linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a marked concave curvature from the median notch towards the distal tips; leading edges exhibit a convex curve terminating in pointed extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, localized circular high-contrast pixel clusters are visible at the distal tip of the left lobe and along the upper margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of numerous distinct, unaligned light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigmentation, primarily oriented diagonally across the mid-section of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged erosion on the distal tips of both lobes and extensive white linear scarring across the central dark pigment field.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense network of intersecting linear streaks creating a unique 'web' pattern against the dark ventral surface.
